Name: CarrotSword
Author: SomniaDream
Description:
在黑暗隧道地图增加了一个自助售卖机
首次下矿会收到一个包裹可以购买胡萝卜剑Added a vending machine to the Dark Tunnel map. Players will receive a parcel on their first mine visit, which can be used to purchase the Carrot Sword.
